item.description:
### Changed - **Undo and SSL Certificates:** the confirmations for Undo (in ZIA Policy, Private Access, Digital Experience, Client Connector, AI Guard and the Policy Simulator's Changes), for an SSL certificate change and for its Undo, and their Help, now say exactly what's checked. Each object or setting is read again just before it's deleted, changed or put back, and left as it is if that read shows a different name or something other than what was set; Digital Experience reads its apps and probes once, before the first change. A change made in the portal after that read isn't caught.
### Fixed - **One window:** the app now has a single window (File › New Window and new tabs are gone), so a change to the tenant can't start in another window while one is still running. Closing the window now quits the app, so a change still running stops, as it does when you quit: wait for it to finish, or stop it. Undo covers what it recorded; a change cut off in the middle of a call may have made one item it couldn't record, and Internet Access changes left pending go live at the next activation. - **Active POVs:** the open POV is now saved when you quit or close the window. Before, a change made in the last moment or two before quitting was lost. - **Active POVs:** resuming a POV file saved without its choices (an edited or hand-made export) now starts every wizard from its defaults and says so. Before, the wizards kept the last POV's choices and saved them into the resumed one. - **POV Start:** after New POV, or resuming another POV, Dry Run & Apply no longer names products of the POV before as not applied by Apply All, and "I've reviewed each dry run" starts unticked. Continuing the POV that's open keeps both. - **Apply pages:** "I've reviewed the dry run" on ZIA Policy, Client Connector, Private Access and Digital Experience now holds only for the dry run you reviewed. If the dry run runs again while the page is open (from POV Start's Run Every Dry Run, including an automatic re-run after a rate limit), it's unticked, as POV Start's is. Resuming or starting another POV unticks it too. Leaving the page and coming back to the same dry run keeps it ticked. - **AI Guard:** when ZIA or AI Guard lists an object without its ID and the dry run would update it (one of the wizard's rules or its AI Guard policy, say) or build on it (the certificate, proxy, proxy gateway, destination group, QUIC network service, URL category or detection policy), the dry run now shows it as a problem and Apply doesn't run. Before, Apply could create a second object of that name, which Undo couldn't take back, or send a rule without the object it points to. - **AI Guard:** when ZIA answers the list of Proxy Chaining certificates, or of proxies, with something other than a list, the certificate picker now says it couldn't read them. Before, it showed no certificates to pick, or didn't mark the one an AI Guard proxy already uses. - **Client Connector:** when Client Connector's answer to a profile delete doesn't say it worked (in Undo, in Manage, or when Apply removes a new forwarding profile after a failed app profile), the app now reads the profile list again. If the profile is still there, or the list can't be read, the delete is reported as failed, and a profile from an Apply stays on its run for the next Undo, instead of counting as deleted. Edit Existing Profiles now warns when Client Connector's answer doesn't confirm an edit, so you can check it in the Mobile Admin portal.
